title: PR review runs cannot move to the reconciler until it grows a review/PR path
body: PR review submits a read_only run for a synthetic per-PR epic; the reconciler's executor issues write and its graph has no such epic, so those runs still boot the container agent (kept working by the credential-grade routing rule). gke (open) tracks the typed review-verdict path; a companion piece is needed to move the PR-review run itself onto the reconciler host, and the routing rule in reconcilerDrives is where that cutover would land.
